title: Chris Kelly's whistle calling musicians back
summary: The whistled call used by Chris and others to call musicians back to the stand.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends

blocks.x: Well let me swap with you, I'll get back over here near the mic and question more. Let's see. I wanted to ask you more about Chris. You said one time that he had some sort of lick he'd play to call the guys back on the stand. How did that go?
Well, da da da da da da. The same thing that they played in the parade.
Yeah. Da da da da da da. That means to come back. I see. You'd notice most of all the musicians would whistle for each other.
They'd whistle that way. Who started that then? I admit it. I know it must be old time.
It's way back. That's what they would do. I don't remember whistling at that time, but they called the musicians, trumpet man called
Or the star of the band, from the getting ready.
